boundary_packet_contract.boundary_representation: cyclic nearest-neighbor triangular-lattice vertex/edge walk supplied by the teacher-geometry registry
boundary_packet_contract.deployable_aggregation: A deployable grammar must specify a deterministic cyclic partition/segmentation policy into disjoint contiguous packets, apply declared surrogates to those packets, and aggregate contributions without hidden overlap or target copying.
boundary_packet_contract.packet: B=(x_0,x_1,...,x_k) contiguous on the cyclic boundary
boundary_packet_contract.packet_catalog_note: The packet catalog may contain overlapping windows for analysis; deployed reconstruction must state how disjoint aggregation is obtained.

evaluation_protocol.data_visibility_rule: Every reported comparison names the teacher-registry version and the exact teacher data visible when the decision was made. If data expand, re-score parent and child on the same comparison set before attributing improvement to the grammar change.
evaluation_protocol.frontier_policy: Maintain a Pareto frontier over error, complexity, and phase/orientation robustness; do not reduce evaluation to one scalar.
evaluation_protocol.primary_objective: global circumference/pi reconstruction across the currently visible teacher corpus

first_round_independence.cross_arm_comparison: Not part of Stage 0 and prohibited before the independent R057G serious grammar checkpoint is frozen.

fit_theorem_separation.invariant: fit_status and theorem_status are separate fields; no fit quality upgrades theorem status.

genealogy_invariant.required_for: Every meaningful grammar/data/search-language change and every selected candidate change that alters the reported frontier or best rule.

hashing_contract.serialization: UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, indent=2, LF newlines, exactly one terminal LF

purpose: Freeze the evolution, supervision, classification, evaluation, and independence rules for R057G before any expensive teacher-corpus generation, packet enumeration, or geometric synthesis.

allowed_now: read the frozen taskbook, frozen problem packet, repository operating rules, and R056 read-only context
define the initial teacher-geometry registry without instantiating the full corpus
define the initial geometric grammar and grammar-evolution meta-rules without running a large search
validate and hash the three Stage-0 protocol artifacts
forbidden_until_driver_review: packet census or exhaustive packet enumeration
geometric grammar synthesis or symbolic-regression search
cross-arm comparison with R057-A selected grammar
stage0_boundary.stop_rule: After freezing and returning the three Stage-0 SHA256 anchors, stop for Driver review.

supervision_policy.epistemic_statement: These uses are legal supervision, not contamination, because R057G is a supervised discovery arm.

target_literal_policy.fitted_parameter_exception: Parameters learned by fitting declared geometric features against pi are allowed and remain supervised fitted parameters, even when their numerical value is close to a familiar constant. Degeneracy is determined by direct target-label/literal use in deployed evaluation, not merely by the fact that pi supervised fitting.
target_literal_policy.rule: A deployed candidate that directly references a pi/teacher-target literal or copies a target contribution so that the answer is tautologically emitted is TARGET_LITERAL_DEGENERATE. It may be retained only as a baseline or sanity upper bound and never counted as structural geometric discovery.
